# Rolfing Amsterdam

> Rolfing Amsterdam is the practice of Janco Volk, a Certified Advanced Rolfer offering Rolfing® Structural Integration in Amsterdam for adults and children.

Rolfing is hands-on bodywork on the connective tissue (fascia) combined with movement and body-awareness work. Janco works with people in chronic or acute pain, stiffness, stress and burnout, after surgery or injury, and before and after pregnancy. The site is in English and Dutch.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.rolfingamsterdam.nl/en): what Rolfing is, who it helps, prices and testimonials
- [What is Rolfing?](https://www.rolfingamsterdam.nl/en/what-is-rolfing): the method, the treatment and who it is for
- [About Janco](https://www.rolfingamsterdam.nl/en/about-janco): training, background and CV
- [FAQ](https://www.rolfingamsterdam.nl/en/faq): sessions, safety and what to expect
- [Book a session](https://www.rolfingamsterdam.nl/en/book-session): booking form, phone and email

## Visit

- Address: Rombout Hogerbeetsstraat 109, 1052 VW Amsterdam
- Hours: TODO-hours
- Bookings: by the form on the site, by phone or by email; sessions not cancelled 24 hours ahead are charged
- Payment: cash or bank transfer after the session

## Services

- Rolfing session for adults, €110: 60 minutes, intake included
- Rolfing session for children under 16, €50: 45 minutes
- Sessions are VAT-exempt; part of the cost is often reimbursed by supplementary health insurance
